capabilities: Move checked items to the bottom of their section
Return unchecked items to the active list
Activate only on notes marked with frontmatter or a #shopping-list tag
Delay reordering while the user is still editing a line
Configure placement of newly checked items
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual from GitHub releases.
problem: Obsidian's task lists stay in place when checked, so completed shopping items clutter the active list as you shop.
summary: Shopping-list plugin that moves checked items to the bottom of their Markdown section and restores them when unchecked.
